mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved corporate earnings prospects.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO above MA has preceded 20d SP
failure_condition: INDPRO rises above MA but SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% signals tight labor markets that drive wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.5% but SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year window.
